title: Prowler (Esperia, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Prowler is a dropship from Esperia in Star Citizen, a copy of an armoured troop carrier of the alien Tevarin. Pilot and second crew member sit in a two-seat cockpit at the front. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Prowler: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Prowler's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The Prowler has two guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Prowler: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Prowler besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Remote turret
controls.text: One remote turret on the Prowler. It is aimed through a camera from inside the ship.
controls.context: A remote turret is aimed from a seat inside the ship through a camera, not from a glass bubble on the turret itself.

controls.name: Troop bay
controls.text: A bay for soldiers who are carried into a fight.
controls.context: The pilot lands the soldiers close to their goal and takes off again.
